How to use: • Sidebar: open chat history and menus • Chat screen: talk with the AI • Settings: download models and set tokens
Initial setup: 1. On the Model tab, run "HuggingFace token auth" 2. Download a model (Gemma 4 2B is recommended)
Other: • "License" shows information about the open-source libraries used
Enjoy chatting with your AI!
Make sure a model is downloaded, then tap the \"+\" button to start a chat.

For models that ship vision integrated into a single GGUF, the vision component is initialized from the same file at load time. For LLaVA-style models that need a separate mmproj file, pick the official mmproj under "Model settings", save, then reload the model.

Please also check GGUF/vision compatibility, file integrity, the mmproj path, and reload after changing settings.
